item.title: Burnham prepares to announce EU trade deals worth billions of pounds
item.body: Andy Burnham is preparing to announce deals with the EU covering areas from youth visas to pet passports. Agriculture and emissions agreements are also nearly tied up, as part of his plan for a much closer relationship with Brussels.

photo.credit: Prime Minister's Office / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🤝 Burnham prepares to announce EU trade deals worth billions of pounds

Andy Burnham is preparing to announce deals with the EU covering areas from youth visas to pet passports. Agriculture and emissions agreements are also nearly tied up, as part of his plan for a much closer relationship with Brussels.

Source: Guardian | Image: Prime Minister's Office / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons
